sections.MESSAGE_TO_USER:
mboetger left three inline comments on #196561 a few minutes before he approved. He's a human reviewer, so I haven't posted anything on GitHub. Draft replies for you are below.

**What I make of them**

1. **`toBigIntegerOrNull()` nit (line 113):** He's right. `value.toBigIntegerOrNull()` in the Kotlin standard library does the same job as our try/catch around `BigInteger(value)`. This is a style change only. Behavior stays the same.
2. **"Android refuses to install" (line 152, 2 comments):** He's right here too. The KDoc on `errorMessage` overstates the problem. An APK with no `versionCode` installs fine with `adb`. It fails in two cases: uploading to the Play Store, and installing over a build that has a `versionCode`. The design decision still holds: suggesting `force-version-code-ignoring-abi` here would still produce APKs you can't ship or upgrade. But the wording is wrong and needs fixing. The comment is on the internal KDoc. I've asked matt561 to check whether the error text users see, or any test, repeats the claim. If it does, that changes my recommendation below.

Neither comment changes behavior. Pushing any commit to #196561 now would dismiss all three approvals, rerun about an hour of presubmits, and delay the 3.50 and 3.51 cherry-picks.

**Decision needed**

1. How to handle these two fixes:
   - 1a. **(Recommended)** Merge #196561 as it is. matt561 puts both fixes in a small follow-up PR from `reidbaker-agent`. The follow-up doesn't need a cherry-pick, because it only touches comments and style.
   - 1b. Push the fixes to #196561 now. You'd get exact wording in the release branches, but it costs three re-approvals, about an hour of CI, and a later cherry-pick.

If matt561 finds the "refuses to install" claim in the message users see, I'll come back and recommend 1b, because then the inaccuracy would ship to users.

matt561 is preparing the commit on a separate local branch now. Nothing will be pushed to #196561 unless you choose 1b. Before you merge, I'll re-run `pr_triage.dart` and re-fetch all threads and reviews on #196561 to make sure nothing else has come in.

**Draft replies for you to post (assuming 1a)**

On r4606831206:
> Good catch. I'll switch this to `value.toBigIntegerOrNull()` in a follow-up so we don't reset approvals before the 3.50/3.51 cherry-picks.

On r4606860038:
> You're right, thanks. adb installs it. What fails is Play Store upload and installing over an existing build that has a versionCode. The flag still can't produce a shippable or upgradable APK in this case, so the message still won't suggest it. I'll correct the KDoc to say that in the same follow-up.

Reply "go" to accept 1a.
sections.WORKER_BRIEF:
matt561: review follow-up for flutter/flutter#196561. Prepare locally only. Don't push yet.

<WORKER-BRIEF>

(Also paste the `reid.md` author brief here, because reidbaker reviews this work.)

**Context.** #196561 ("Fix --split-per-abi versionCode when android {} omits versionCode") has three approvals (reidbaker, bkonyi, mboetger) and green CI. Branch: `vcfix-manifest-fallback`, head `f3d2ab1fd3b`. Any push to that branch dismisses the approvals and reruns about an hour of presubmits, and the user wants to cherry-pick it into 3.50 and 3.51 as soon as it lands. So **don't push to `vcfix-manifest-fallback`**, and don't open a PR, until I tell you which way the user decided.

**Review comments from mboetger (human reviewer).** Don't reply on GitHub. Draft any replies in your report.

Comment 1, `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt` line 113, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606831206
> nit: toBigIntegerOrNull() exists

It's on:
```kotlin
val versionCode =
    try {
        BigInteger(value)
    } catch (e: NumberFormatException) {
        null
    }
```

Comments 2 and 3, one thread on `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt` line 152, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606860038
> I don't think this is true.  Can't submit to Play Store sure - but I was able to install with adb.

> I believe it will reject if you try to install over a build with a versionCode.

It's on the KDoc of `errorMessage(variantName, reason)`, specifically: "When the manifest has no positive `versionCode`, the flag builds APKs with no `versionCode`, which Android refuses to install."

**Task**
1. Create local branch `vcfix-review-followup` from `f3d2ab1fd3b`.
2. Comment 1: replace the try/catch with `value.toBigIntegerOrNull()`. Confirm the behavior is identical for the inputs the existing tests cover.
3. Comments 2 and 3: correct the KDoc. APKs with no `versionCode` install with `adb`, but the Play Store rejects them and they can't be installed over a build that has a `versionCode`. So `force-version-code-ignoring-abi` still doesn't give a shippable or upgradable result, and the message still shouldn't suggest it. Keep the sentence about a non-decimal value failing the AGP build if it's accurate.
4. **Check first and report:** search the whole PR diff (`git diff origin/main...f3d2ab1fd3b`) for any other place that makes the "refuses to install" claim, especially the error string users see in `errorMessage`, other comments, tests, and the PR description. List each place with file and line. Fix them in the same commit, and tell me plainly whether the text users see contains the claim.
5. Run the Gradle plugin's unit tests that cover `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper`, plus the analysis and format checks, and report the results.
6. Weigh each comment on its merits and mark it changed, modified or declined, with your reason.

**Report back with:** the commit SHA, the full diff, the test results, your answer to step 4, and draft replies to both threads.

**After I relay the user's decision:**
- If the user picks the follow-up PR: once #196561 lands, merge `origin/main` into `vcfix-review-followup` (never rebase). Then push to the `reidbaker-agent` fork and open the PR from `reidbaker-agent:vcfix-review-followup`.
- If the user picks pushing now: I'll tell you to put the commit on `vcfix-manifest-fallback` instead.
